text_sanskrit: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते । तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥ १३-२६ ॥
itrans: anye tvevamajAnantaH shrutvAnyebhya upAsate . te.api chAtitarantyeva mR^ityu.n shrutiparAyaNAH .. 13-26 ..
translation: But the rest (men) who cannot thus know, hear (learn) from others and contemplate, and even those devoted to learning and the knowledge by study surely cross over death (Samsâra)
